Author: Jean Almeida
Name: Uptime Monitor
Description: Monitor any website or server right from your Ulanzi Deck. Enter a URL and the key shows a live status with a real-time latency graph: green when up, orange on instability/high latency, and a blinking red when it goes down. Configurable check interval and thresholds, modern animated UI, and full localization. Keep an eye on your sites, APIs and services at a glance.
